content.user_title: Search and Rewrite Code with ast-grep
content.value_statement: Large codebases make text search miss structural patterns. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code to use ast-grep for syntax-aware search, linting, and rewrites.
actual_capabilities: Explains when to use ast-grep instead of text search.
Provides command examples for pattern search, scan, test, and rewrite workflows.
Describes YAML rule elements such as pattern, kind, relationship rules, and logical combinations.
Guides rule debugging with example snippets and stopBy usage.
Shows common workflows for audits, API migrations, and refactors.
limitations: Requires ast-grep or sg to be installed in the local environment.
Does not provide a bundled executable, wrapper script, or automated installer.
Rule quality depends on correct language selection and valid AST patterns.
Large rewrites still need review and tests before merging.

use_cases.title: Find Structural Code Patterns
use_cases.description: Locate functions, calls, imports, and control flow by syntax instead of raw text.

use_cases.title: Run Repository-Wide Refactors
use_cases.description: Create ast-grep rules to replace APIs, update imports, or migrate code patterns across many files.

use_cases.title: Search for Risky Constructs
use_cases.description: Use syntax-aware queries to find eval calls, SQL query patterns, or other audit targets.

prompt_templates.title: Find a Simple Pattern
prompt_templates.prompt: Find every console.log call in this TypeScript project with ast-grep. Show the command and explain the pattern.

prompt_templates.title: Write a Lint Rule
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an ast-grep YAML rule that matches async functions without await. Include a short test plan.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Rewrite
prompt_templates.prompt: Design an ast-grep rewrite to replace old API calls with new API calls across TypeScript files. Include review steps.

prompt_templates.title: Build a Migration Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a multi-rule ast-grep workflow for an API migration. Cover search, test, rewrite, and post-change verification.

output_examples.input: Find every debugging log in a TypeScript codebase.
output_examples.output: A syntax-aware search plan with the ast-grep language flag, pattern choice, and review guidance.

output_examples.input: Prepare a bulk rename from an old helper to a new helper.
output_examples.output: A rewrite workflow that tests the rule first, applies the change, and calls out files requiring review.
A focused search plan that targets eval-style calls and separates findings from expected test fixtures.

best_practices: Test each rule on a small sample before scanning the full repository.
Use stopBy: end for relationship rules that must search the full subtree.
Review generated rewrites with normal tests and version control diffs.
anti_patterns: Do not run broad rewrites without a clean working tree and a rollback plan.
Do not use text-only patterns when syntax structure is required.
Do not assume a rule is correct before testing it against known examples.

faq.question: Does this skill install ast-grep?
faq.answer: No. It explains installation options, but the user must install ast-grep separately.

faq.question: Can it rewrite code automatically?
faq.answer: It can guide ast-grep rewrite commands. Users should review diffs and run tests after every rewrite.

faq.question: Which languages can it support?
faq.answer: It follows ast-grep language support. The correct language flag or rule language must be selected.

faq.question: How is this different from grep?
faq.answer: ast-grep matches syntax tree structure, so it can find code patterns that text search misses.

faq.question: Can it help with security audits?
faq.answer: Yes. It can guide searches for risky syntax patterns, but humans must validate each result.

faq.question: Does it include custom scripts?
faq.answer: No. The skill is Markdown guidance with examples for using the external ast-grep CLI.
